authoring_note: Roadmap only, no production rollout claims. Planned thresholds are hypotheses.
approval_mode: scope/engineering planning, not automatic release authorization
delivery_type: World-first creator network, transparent contextual sponsorship, gradual self-serve advertising
north_star: Weekly Meaningful World Connections (unique verified two-sided human interactions in a World per week)

current_verified.backend: No accessible Supabase projects in connected account
current_verified.staging: SSH host key mismatch; no bypass

gates.condition: Inventory completed, legal and SSH risk understood; 10 real creators find World useful
100 creators invited, >=40% of new creators publish within 7 days, no high-severity privacy bugs
gates.exit_if_failed: fix onboarding and privacy before growth

gates.condition: >=20% cohort D30 creator retention when measurable, pilot brand demand validated
gates.exit_if_failed: pivot positioning; do not scale paid acquisition

gates.condition: >=10 real paid pilots and >=30% repeat over defined period, verified views and no severe ad incidents
sustainable repeat-purchase contribution margin and World retention; country-safe operations
gates.exit_if_failed: stay in profitable focused vertical, no false worldwide expansion
